ns2:section.sectionText: Introductory skills and knowledge essential for handling a canoe with safety. The ability to jump or dive into deep water while clothed and maintain a survival position for 10 minutes. For current fees, see Schedule. A one day field trip on a Friday to a local river/lake is required. Additional class activity fee required which includes equipment (canoes, PFD's, paddles, etc.) and supplies used throughout the 8 weeks course.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Kinesio/Camp Rec Facility Fee $100.00 Flat Fee.
